name: Cultivation Prodigy
body:
You are a generational prodigy, able to seamlessly use your spiritual energies fluidly among the various learned spiritual traditions you learn.

Prerequisite(s): Int, Wis, or Cha 13+, character level 5th, and at least two separate classes you possess that grants you ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve.

Benefit(s): You pool together the levels in all classes you possess that grant you points to a ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve ability to determine the total number of points in the combined pool, but only one of the associated mental ability score modifiers is added to the total. The choice of which ability score to use is made when you take this feat; it cannot be later changed.

You use the points from this combined pool to power any of your class abilities, feats, or spells that use points from ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve.
